                 CHARLES GLENDON STOVALL, JR.’S INITIAL BRIEF

       My name is Charles Glendon Stovall, Jr. I am the landowner for Parcel # 5135 on the G9

Line of the proposed 765KV Transmission Line. The Property is owned by The Stovall Family

Trust, and I am a principal of that entity. The property address is 1442 Moon Ranch Road,

Florence, Texas 76527 in Burnet County.

       I am deeply opposed to the 765KV Transmission Line on my property. We always had a

dream of owning a piece of the beautiful Texas Hill Country, and in 2015 that dream came true.

In 2021 we custom built our home not ever thinking about the horrors of huge transmission towers

ruining our views. The construction of the transmission lines will destroy a major water source

which our wildlife and animals depend on, and also eliminate a perimeter road to access a good

portion of our ranch. This road also serves as a critical firebreak between properties. Other

concerns would be future health problems from EMF’s and the devaluation of our land. Our

property is located at the end of a narrow, one lane dirt road 1.5 miles off of the paved county road.

There are twelve families who also live on this narrow dirt road, which sometimes causes traffic




                                                  1
 congestion, so you can only imagine the headache if large trucks from the LCRA or Oncor tried

to travel the road all at the same time as any of the residents.

       It is my hope that the 765 KV Transmission Lines find a better home than the G9 route

offers. One which is more suitable and more cost effective. Please don’t turn our dream into a

nightmare!



                                                       Thank you for your consideration,

                                                       Charles Stovall
